gold_policy: Only layer=adjudicated and state=adjudicated is gold.

similarity_method.acceptance: length_ratio>=0.72 and (token_jaccard>=0.86 or token_jaccard>=0.68 and char5_jaccard>=0.84)
similarity_method.candidate_generation: eight 8-bit SimHash bands over token trigrams
similarity_method.normalization: NFKD lowercase; digits and redaction tokens masked

subagent_council.candidate_policy: Council output is suggestion data unless separately adjudicated.
subagent_council.pass_rule: 3 of 3 exact normalized subagent annotation signatures must agree; otherwise queue round+1.

text_definition: title + newline + body_redacted; UTF-8; offsets are Python/Unicode code points
